VISUAL.description: Inspect actual desktop/narrow preview and shared cards/backdrops/navigation. Self-inspection is not an independent human approval.

SOURCE-REVIEW.description: Record applicable CS01-CS10 ownership, preservation, readability and bounded-check review. No runtime/style change or new clock/budget is introduced.

Maintainer authorised this sequence on 19 October; green tests cannot supply missing rights/review decisions.
